zh.title: 研究發現客艙空氣化學物質具內分泌擾亂活性
zh.summary: 新研究顯示42種有機磷化合物中88%擾亂荷爾蒙受體；航空引擎油中的三苯基磷酸鹽效應最強。
body: 根據Aerospace Global News報導，一項經同儕評審的研究檢測了42種有機磷化合物及商業混合物，發現其中88%的化合物在低於造成一般細胞毒性的濃度下，即可干擾雌激素或雄激素受體活性。
研究指出， aryl 和 triaryl 磷酸鹽（包括航空渦輪引擎油中的防磨添加劑）展現出最強的內分泌擾亂效應，所有測試的 triaryl 磷酸鹽群組均具有內分泌活性，其中三分之一在低於1 mg/L濃度下即顯現效應。
雖然研究未證實飛艙氣味事件直接導致不孕或其他健康問題，但作者指出這些化學物質先前已在客艙空氣中被檢測出，現在顯示出與生殖危害相關的生物活性。

en.title: Study links aircraft cabin air chemicals to endocrine disruption
en.summary: New study shows 88% of 42 organophosphate compounds disrupt hormone receptors; aryl and triaryl phosphates from turbine oil strongest.
body: Aerospace Global News reports that a peer‑reviewed study assessed 42 organophosphate compounds and commercial mixtures, finding that 88% disrupted estrogen or androgen receptor activity at concentrations below those causing general cell toxicity.

The aryl and triaryl phosphate group, which includes anti‑wear additives used in aircraft turbine oils, produced some of the strongest effects; all triaryl phosphates tested showed endocrine activity, with one‑third active below 1 mg/L.

While the study does not prove that fume events cause infertility or reproductive illness, it notes that these chemicals have previously been detected in cabin air and now exhibit biological activity linked to reproductive harm.
